source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Click on the type of record with the appropriate description.
3. Click on the red X next to the test type of interest.
4. Click on Failed Test.
5. Click on Remarks.
6. Type a comment here about why the test failed. Do not make comments about when repairs were made.
   _It is important for the tester to be able to document the reason a test failed and to the best of his/her ability, why they think tests failed.  It is necessary to do this accurately so that an investigation of brake failures can be executed by a mechanic or supervisor. If the mechanic or supervisor cannot clearly see the issue and resolve, contact the inspector for further information._
7. Click Finish.
8. Click Confirm.
9. Restart the test by clicking on the  and re-start the test if repairs have been made and the same vehicle is brought back in.
